authorized_band.restriction: Only morphology whose relief is separable from the published campaign error may enter a later support/error probe. The source does not by itself qualify all B1 wavelengths or amplitudes.

decision.next_action: Freeze a sand.dune_aeolian or shore.beach_sand claim around the exact 2022-02 artifact, then run the existing target-specific semantics, support, interpolation, error, analogue, and site-split gates before training or synthesis.

using interpolated cells without a measured support mask

dataset.title: Virginia Tech StREAM Lab Spring 2026 Drone Lidar Survey
dataset.platform: DJI Matrice 350 RTK with Zenmuse L1

dtm.semantics: Minimum elevation from provider ground plus unassigned classes; voids and stream surface were linearly interpolated.

control_and_error.alignment: Spring 2026 was aligned to Winter 2021 by ICP on three bridges; no alignment residual distribution is reported.

blocking_reasons: No independent Spring 2026 terrain check-point distribution is published.
The report explicitly leaves known ground/vegetation streambank misclassifications unverified and uncorrected.
The DTM includes low-return unassigned points and linearly interpolated stream bathymetry, so its surface semantics and support are insufficient for target truth.

dataset.title: Survey of Point Beach, Wisconsin, August 2020

blocking_reasons: The published 0.72 m vertical and 0.77 m total control-point RMSE cannot support B1 geometry.
The cloud is unclassified and does not provide a terrain-semantic or support mask.

dataset.title: Set of DEM models from a section of the dune coast in Mrzezyno (Poland) - demo data for testing in the CMORPH application.
dataset.processing: Flight strips were boresight-corrected and merged; adaptive-TIN ground classification was visually checked on dense cross-shore profiles; ground points were inverse-distance interpolated to a 0.10 m DEM.

geometry_member.required_ingest_policy: Mask the declared nodata value and fail closed or explicitly mask the three non-nodata extreme cells; never treat them as terrain.

primary_paper.title: Multi-temporal UAV analysis of beach-dune morphodynamics in Mrzezyno on the southern Baltic coast (Poland)
primary_paper.relationship: The paper covers the 2022-02-28 campaign date and states that 2022 campaigns used Zenmuse L1 LiDAR.

simultaneous_lidar_sfm_morphometric_comp.interpretation: Extracted shoreline, dune-toe, and dune-crest locations are substantially less certain than direct raster elevation comparisons and may not label fine morphology.

surface_semantics.included: Provider-classified terrain ground across a Baltic beach-dune section, including vegetated dune ground where LiDAR returns survived classification.
excluded_or_unresolved: material labels separating dry beach, wet beach, and dune sand

candidates.pass_reason: This is downloadable metric geometry under CC-BY-4.0 from a physically relevant Baltic sand regime, with explicit terrain-ground processing and campaign-level independent RTK error evidence. It is therefore eligible for a bounded B1 support/error probe, but not accepted target truth.
candidates.resume_or_reject_gate: Reject or narrow the claim if a frozen probe cannot construct per-cell support/interpolation masks or cannot show that the claimed B1 signal exceeds total error. Do not compensate by tuning synthesis thresholds.
